# CloudCostMatrix

> Independent multi-cloud cost calculator. Prices compute, object storage, managed databases, networking/egress and
> managed Kubernetes across ten providers — AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, IBM Cloud,
> DigitalOcean, Alibaba Cloud, Linode (Akamai), OVHcloud and Vultr — from each provider's published list rates, using
> one cost engine so the numbers are comparable side by side. No signup, no runtime API calls: the pricing catalog is
> compiled into the site at build time and refreshed on a schedule from provider pricing APIs.

Every figure is directional list pricing for architecture planning, not a quote. Per-provider provenance (what is
live-synced, what is benchmarked, and the caveats behind each) is documented at /methodology.

## Entry points

- [Home / live estimator](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/): configure an architecture and compare all ten providers.
- [Provider pricing directory](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/providers): every provider, with entry pricing and rankings.
- [Comparisons](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/compare): all 45 provider pairs, each with a computed verdict.
- [Cost guides](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/guides): rankings by egress, entry compute, object storage, managed
  PostgreSQL, managed Kubernetes, and EU data residency.
- [Architecture blueprints](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/blueprints): four reference architectures priced across all
  providers.
- [Methodology](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/methodology): how costs are calculated and verified.
- [Pricing data freshness](https://cloudcostmatrix.com/methodology): live-sync status per provider and category.

## Notes for automated readers

- All pages listed above are statically prerendered; the sitemap at https://cloudcostmatrix.com/sitemap.xml is the
  authoritative list of indexable URLs.
- Shareable architecture URLs use an `?c=` query parameter and are deliberately excluded from the sitemap.
- Prices change when the sync pipeline runs; pages carry their own freshness label and source URL.
